body:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission.

Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. We own the model and the systems of record for what a customer bought: their commitments, their pricing terms, how many organizations roll up to one agreement, and the automation that provisions a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold. When a deal closes, our systems decide what the customer is entitled to, what they pay, and what Finance reports.

We're looking for an engineering manager to lead this team. You'll hire and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own how it delivers. Success looks like new deal structures shipping as configuration rather than one-off engineering, and signed deals provisioning automatically, with the rare exception routed to someone who can fix it.

Key responsibilities

• Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and develop engineers, give clear and honest feedback, and build a team that owns its domain end to end.

• Own the commercial data model. Set the direction for how commitments, pricing terms, account hierarchies, and entitlements are modeled, so a new deal structure extends the model instead of working around it.

• Own the pricing primitives: the catalog of products and rates, and the constructs that let contracted pricing follow a customer across products and new model launches.

• Make the contract the source of truth. Build systems of record that Finance can close the books on and trace back to the signed contract, with reconciliation against the CRM and every downstream billing system designed in from the start.

• Automate the path from signature to a live customer. Lead the durable workflows that provision a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold, recover from partial failure, and route exceptions to the right person with the context to resolve them.

• Build for people and agents. Own the interfaces for agreements, entitlements, and pricing terms that seller tools and Claude-powered agents read and write, so both get the same safe, auditable capabilities.

• Own planning and delivery. Turn competing asks from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and product teams into a clear roadmap, make the trade-offs explicit, and hold the team to its milestones.

• Operate what you ship. Set SLOs on the flows your team runs, instrument them so discrepancies surface before month-end close, and keep on-call sustainable as volume grows.

Minimum qualifications

• 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering teams including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• A strong background building production backend systems, with enough depth in a language such as Go, Python, or Java to review designs and code.

• Experience leading teams that built billing, payments, pricing, contract management, or other financial systems of record in production.

• Experience modeling transactional or financial data, including relational databases and SQL.

• Experience leading teams that built and operated asynchronous, long-running workflows, such as on a durable workflow engine like Temporal or on queues and state machines.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building CPQ, contract management, or quote-to-cash platforms, and firsthand knowledge of how one change to pricing terms ripples through quoting, provisioning, invoicing, and revenue reporting.

• Experience with enterprise commercial structures such as multi-year or ramped commitments, drawdowns, amendments and renewals, or one agreement shared across many accounts.

• Experience integrating or extending third-party billing, payment, or CRM platforms, and opinions on where they fall short.

• Experience building revenue reconciliation or financial reporting pipelines, or systems that had to pass a financial audit.

• Experience automating a high-touch operational process and measuring the manual work it removed.

• Experience building LLM-powered tools or agents, or systems designed for agents to call safely.

• Experience growing a team through a period of rapid company growth.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$405,000 — $485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍London / UK Remote | 💰£142,000 - £170,000 + Benefits ✨

Our Financial Control team ⭐

We are seeking an experienced finance operations leader for a 12-month fixed-term contract to lead our Global Financial Operations and Control team. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.

Your mandate is to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program. You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

• Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.

• Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.

• Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.

• Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.

• Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.

• Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.

• Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.

• Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.

• Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.

• Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.

• Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.

Role Scope Clarification

• Included: Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.

• Excluded: Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred).

• You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.

• You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.

• You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.

• You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.

• Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.

• You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.

• You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS)

Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

💰 £142,000 - £170,000.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

🌈 The application journey has 5 key steps

• Initial Call with the Recruiter

• Hiring Manager Interview

• Role Specific Interview

• Behavioural Interview

• Final Interview with the Team

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.

#LI-TP1 #LI-REMOTE

As our Senior Legal Counsel for Employment Law, you will be the go-to trusted advisor on both individual and collective employment law matters, ensuring compliance with local and EU regulations while supporting diversity and inclusion initiatives. This role manages negotiation strategies and leads complex works council negotiations, reviews employment related agreements, represents the company in employment disputes, and advises on employee relations issues. Additionally, it ensures proper data handling, maintains up to date knowledge of legal developments, and aligns organisational policies with legal requirements and best practices.

In this role you will be responsible for:

•
Strategic Advisory: Provide expert, business-oriented legal counsel on the full spectrum of individual and collective employment law—including employment contracts, compensation structures, terminations, benefits, and anti-discrimination topics.

•
Works Council Partnership: Lead negotiation strategies and build constructive, collaborative relationships with the Works Council to co-create impactful works agreements.

•
Agreements & Documentation: Review employment contracts, offer frameworks, and operational workforce templates, empowering People Operations to move fast while staying compliant.

•
Dispute Resolution & Advocacy: Represent the business in employment-related disputes, proactively defending against claims while protecting our reputation and core values.

•
Employee Relations Support: Advise leadership and people teams on sensitive employee relations topics, from performance management and disciplinary actions to complex grievances.

•
Progressive Policy Design: Shape internal guidelines that champion fairness and comply with local laws, EU directives, and modern Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) best practices.

•
Employee Data Governance: Safeguard employee trust by ensuring workforce data handling and retention practices remain strictly compliant with GDPR and privacy standards.

•
Future-Proofing & Horizon Scanning: Stay ahead of key legal developments and EU directives, translating regulatory changes into proactive, practical business advantages.

•
Complex Collective Negotiations: Confidently lead the end-to-end negotiation process on nuanced, high-stakes Works Council matters.

What you need to be successful:

•
German qualified lawyer (e.g. German 1. and 2. Staatsexamen).

• Substantial experience practicing German employment law.

• Proven fluency in German co-determination mechanics and a track record of building positive, productive relationships with employee representation bodies (Works Councils).

• Relevant work experience either from a law firm or in-house.

•
Experienced in organisational development and change management and you have a broad understanding of employee relations and employee representation.

Desired Personal Attributes

•
Fluent in both German and English, comfortable negotiating and drafting in both languages.

•
Solutions-driven approach with a knack for translating complex legal nuances into clear, actionable advice that supports business momentum.

•
High emotional intelligence, capable of building seamless relationships across People teams, executive leadership, and employee representatives.

•
Uncompromising ethical standards and calm discretion when managing sensitive matters.

Skills & Competencies

•
Analytical & Drafting Excellence: Strong ability to synthesize legal research into crisp, persuasive, and practical documentation.

•
Negotiation & Tact: Natural conflict-resolution skills with the diplomacy needed to navigate complex human dynamics and reach win-win outcomes.

•
Creative Problem-Solving: Resourceful approach to tackling novel or ambiguous employment challenges.

• Agile Project Management: Structured and organised, with the agility to manage change and deliver high-impact initiatives smoothly.

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

About the opportunity:

As a Forecasting Expert in the WFM team, you are responsible for producing high quality demand forecasts for different workstreams across operations. Your forecasts will be used for capacity planning, budget planning, and shift scheduling of our in-house teams and external partners. Additionally your forecasting expertise will be used to support the implementation of new products and key initiatives, and you will be the internal go-to person for forecasting related questions. You will challenge existing frameworks and implement innovative solutions using your experience and knowledge.

In this role, you will:

•
Forecast resource requirements across different teams and workstreams to meet customer/stakeholder demand and required service levels.

•
Produce analytics on forecast performance, as well as volume evolution and the effect of internal or external factors on volume such as new product launches.

•
Assist in the further development of forecasting methodologies, models and tools in order to increase forecast accuracy and efficiency.

•
Partner with Growth, Membership, and Product Teams to understand the key drivers of volume and incorporate them into the forecasting and planning process.

•
Provide consultative support for the leadership team, guiding and advising to develop effective productivity measures, performance management intelligence and resource planning effectiveness.

•
Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.

•
Maintain an accurate events log detailing what is included in the forecast and reasons for variance to forecast.

What you need to be successful:

•
2+ years of experience working in demand forecasting, resource planning, or directly related field

•
Advanced level of ability in applied mathematics, statistics, scenario modelling, demand modelling and analysis

•
Expert with Excel or Google Sheets, and ability with SQL, Python, or R is a huge plus

•
Experience with business analytics platforms such as Google Looker, Metabase, or similar systems

•
Graduated with a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or other related field of study/relevant level of professional experience

Traits:

•
Actively help yourself (and others) be successful.

•
Continuously learn and challenge the status quo.

•
Think globally, act locally.

•
Strong bias for action.

•
Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback.

At N26, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking, multicultural environment where innovation and compliance go hand in hand. You’ll lead impactful work that safeguards our customers and helps shape the future of compliant digital banking across Europe.

If you’re passionate about leadership, compliance, and operational excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help us build a safer, smarter banking experience.

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are
N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.
We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

body:
Unter der Aufsicht der BaFin steuert N26 die Interaktionen mit 7 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden in 24 Märkten. Im Rahmen unseres ambitionierten Vorhabens, den Bereich Compliance in diesen Interaktionen weiter zu stärken, schaffen wir eine Position zur federführenden Operationalisierung der regulatorischen Dimension im Austausch mit Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Behörden.

Sie verantworten das Kontrollwesen: Sie konzipieren Kontrollmechanismen, dokumentieren diese und erbringen die Nachweise, die von der Internen Revision, unseren externen Prüfern sowie der Aufsichtsbehörde geprüft werden. Dabei steigen Sie zu einem Zeitpunkt ein, zu dem wesentliche Gestaltungs- und Richtungsentscheidungen noch aktiv getroffen werden – nicht erst im Nachhinein.

Was Sie verantworten

• Die Umsetzungs-Roadmap: jede Maßnahme zu jedem Feststellungspunkt termingerecht konzipiert, dokumentiert, eingeführt und nachgewiesen (Test of Design, Test of Effectiveness).

• Präventive Ursachenanalyse: ein risikobasiertes Verfahren, das Beschwerden nach Auswirkung (finanzieller Schaden, aufsichtsrechtlich, Reputation) auswählt, nicht nur nach Volumen, und sie in Produkt- und Prozessänderungen überführt.

• Die schriftlich fixierte Ordnung des Beschwerdemanagements über alle Märkte: aktuell, konsistent, prüfbar.

• Die laufende Schnittstelle zu Compliance, Risikomanagement, Interner Revision und externen Prüfern für Kontrollen im Beschwerdemanagement.

• Eine Associate-Stelle (Compliance & Prevention) sowie die bereichsübergreifenden Arbeitsstränge mit Produkt, Technik, Legal und Customer Service.

Was Sie mitbringen: drei Dinge

• Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1); Englisch fließend.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon Prüfungs-, Assurance-, IKS- oder Compliance-Tätigkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld: Bank, Zahlungs- oder E-Geld-Institut, Versicherer oder die Prüfungs- und Beratungsgesellschaften, die diese betreuen. Auf welcher Seite des Tisches Sie saßen, ist zweitrangig.

• Sie können eine aufsichtsrechtliche Anforderung in eine dokumentierte Kontrolle übersetzen, einführen und deren Wirksamkeit nachweisen, und Sie haben das unter Prüfungsdruck schon getan.

Hilfreich, nicht Bedingung

• Erfahrung in Beschwerdebearbeitung, Streitbeilegung oder Ombudsverfahren.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Complaints Operations & Service Delivery to lead the day-to-day complaints operation of N26 across all our markets, with focus on Germany.

Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Service & Complaints Management and Prevention, you will own how the operation performs: regulatory deadlines met in every market, capacity planned rather than improvised, productivity defined and tracked, quality assured and continuity guaranteed.

The complaints market managers report to you; you steer the quality-assurance and workforce-management specialists who support complaints; you work hand in hand with our Compliance & Prevention function, which designs the controls you operate; and you act as designated deputy to the Head of department for complaints operations. This is a hands-on senior operations role in a supervised, high-scrutiny environment — the right job for someone who has turned an operation around on SLAs before and can prove it with numbers.

What You Will Do

• Service Delivery & SLA Ownership: Own regulatory timeliness and backlog across DE/AT, FR, ES, IT and Greater Europe; set queue strategy and prioritisation rules; run the daily and weekly operating rhythm; intervene before thresholds are breached, not after.

• Capacity & Workforce Planning: Own the complaints forecast, staffing model and scheduling, including BPO volume steering; translate volume trends and regulatory changes (e.g. new deadline regimes) into capacity decisions; keep the capacity model current and evidenced.

• Productivity & Operational Excellence: Define productivity standards per market and team, track them monthly, and drive the adoption of optimisation measures — routing, templates, tooling, automation — together with Operational Readiness and our Product & Tech partners.

• Quality Assurance: Run the QA system for complaints output — sampling, calibration across markets, feedback loops, rework reduction — so that quality is measured, not assumed.

• Business Continuity: Own the contingency plan for the complaints operation: triggers, surge playbooks, cross-market and BPO backup, regular tests.

• Team Leadership: Lead, develop and hold accountable the complaints market managers; build operational-management capability in the team; manage performance with facts.

• Evidence & Governance: Produce the operating evidence (reports, sign-offs, exceptions and their handling) that Compliance & Prevention, Internal Audit and external reviewers test; represent complaints operations in management and audit forums and deputise for the Head of department on complaints operations.

What You Will Bring

• Minimal requirements:

• 7+ years in customer or complaints operations in regulated financial services (bank, payment or e-money institution, insurer), including 3+ years leading managers of managers or a multi-site / multi-market operation.

• A demonstrable track record of lifting SLA attainment and productivity in an operation of comparable size (50+ FTE in-house and/or BPO).

• Full professional proficiency in English.

• Background & Experience: Service delivery, workforce management or operational-excellence leadership; experience steering BPO partners on forecast, quality and cost; exposure to audits or regulatory remediation as an operational owner.

• Functional & Technical Knowledge : Forecasting and capacity planning, scheduling, queue and skills-based routing, QA calibration and productivity metrics; practical knowledge of complaint-handling timelines (PSD2 15 / 35 business days, national regimes) and delay-notification duties; case-management and BI tooling (Salesforce, Metabase or equivalent).

• Leadership: Direct, fact-based and calm under scrutiny; able to develop managers who are strong on content into strong operators; comfortable presenting to senior management and auditors.

• Languages: Fluent English required; German or Spanish is a strong plus.

What's in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most innovative banks 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are?

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1700 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Madrid and Barcelona.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position!

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models.

This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types.

Your day-to-day

• Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected

• Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts

• Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users

• Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely

• Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required

• Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions

• Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve

• Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees

• Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation

You should apply if you:

• Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling

• Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle

• Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team.

• Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential

• Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus.

• Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts

• Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

• Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure

• dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing

• Python for data science and machine learning

• Go to write our application code

• AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

• A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling and model risk teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.

About the opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager Business Audit | French Market to lead and support the internal audit activities of the N26 Group, with a focus on the French market and topics such as AML/AFC/KYC.

Our Internal Audit team manages the full audit cycle to ensure operational effectiveness, reliability, and compliance with all applicable policies and regulations.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to participate in strategic projects, develop detailed risk-based audit plans, and ensure compliance with professional and regulatory standards at the highest level.

In this role, you will:

• Lead and support all internal business audit activities across the N26 Group, including external service providers and subsidiaries, with a primary focus on the N26 French branch and AML/AFC/KYC topics.

• Prepare and manage the full audit cycle, including risk and control management regarding the effectiveness, reliability, and compliance of business operations.

• Develop and update a comprehensive, risk-based annual audit plan across various business functions (such as Product, Customer Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships).

• Draft detailed written internal audit reports and present findings and agreed action plans to the Executive Board and relevant committees.

• Monitor and follow up on the timely remediation of audit findings and identified deficiencies within agreed timelines.

• Contribute to key strategic projects, maintain internal audit policies, and supervise and review the work of junior team members to ensure successful delivery.

What you need to be successful:

Background:

• A Bachelor's degree or a comparable successfully completed degree in accounting, finance, business administration, economics, or a related field.

• At least 7 years of solid professional experience as an Internal Auditor in an international, regulated environment, preferably in a bank, another financial institution, or an audit firm.

• Significant experience in risk controlling and in the validation of financial and non-financial risks, as well as profound knowledge of French banking, anti-money laundering (AML), and consumer protection regulations.

About the opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

In this role, you will

• Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.

• Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.

• Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.

• Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.

• Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.

• Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

What you need to be successful

Background & Experience

• 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.

• High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.

• Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

Technical & Domain Skills

• Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.

• Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.

• Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.

• Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

Traits

• Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.

• Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.

• Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

What’s in it for you

• Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.

• Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.

• A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.

• An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

Our EU team ⭐

Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo.

Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.

You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.

Shaping product and commercial strategy:

• You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.

• You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.

Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:

• You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.

• Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.

Changing how decisions get made:

• You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.

• You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.

Building and leading a high-performing team:

• You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.

• You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!

• You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.

• You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.

• You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.

• You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.

• You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.

• You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

• 30 minute recruiter call

• 60 minute call with the hiring manager

• 4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Payments

• A meet and greet with a member of EU Executive Committee

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

About the opportunity

We are seeking an Internal IT Auditor to conduct the full IT audit cycle, ensuring operational effectiveness, reliability, and regulatory compliance across our internal IT environments and critical ICT third-party ecosystems.
Our Internal Audit team provides independent assurance over risk and control management, and follows proactive risk mitigation and robust governance to safeguard our digital banking environment.
This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping our IT resilience, where you will engage directly with internal architecture teams and critical external vendors to navigate the evolving landscape of digital banking and European financial regulations.

In this role, you will:

• Execute the full audit cycle: Perform comprehensive risk and control management over IT operations to ensure effectiveness, reliability, and adherence to established professional and regulatory standards.

• Audit critical ICT services & vendors: Lead audits of third-party vendors, outsourced service providers, and cloud infrastructures, evaluating their control environments and how internal processes govern these external services.

• Analyze data and IT processes: Obtain and evaluate documentation, flowcharts, and data using data-driven audit approaches for system development, IT security, and vendor management.

• Deliver impactful reporting: Prepare detailed Internal Audit reports that translate complex technical findings into business-relevant insights and actionable recommendations for senior management.

• Drive continuous improvement: Continuously monitor the IT and ICT vendor risk landscape, facilitate alignment discussions, and advise management on best practices and risk remediation actions.

What you need to be successful:

• 6 years of significant experience functioning as an Internal IT Auditor at an international company within a regulated environment (preferably a bank, financial institution, fintech, or an audit/consulting firm).

• Holding professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISSP, or comparable qualifications, are a plus.

• Deep understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), modern IT/cloud architectures, operational resilience frameworks, and ICT Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).

• Solid understanding of European financial regulatory frameworks relevant to IT and outsourcing, particularly DORA, and MaRisk.

• Experience in data-driven audit approaches, including large-scale data evaluation, and proficiency in modern audit tools and platforms.

• Strong ability to engage effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external ICT service providers, including reviewing third-party assurance attestations (e.g. SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO, ISAE 3402).

• High level of integrity and professional skepticism, combined with excellent interpersonal skills to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Fluency in English is required (verbal and written). German is a plus.

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

body:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍 London or Barcelona | UK remote | 💰 £124,400 - 165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology — Data

We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and can apply both to Monzo’s most important and complex challenges.

At Monzo, we’re building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.

Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.

Our Data Science team ⭐

We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

• Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work

• Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs

• Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes

• Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster

• Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks

• Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions

• Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them

• Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work

• Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge

• Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes

• You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement

• You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk

• You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action

• You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility

• You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues

The interview process:

Our interview process involves:

• Recruiter Call

• Initial Call

• Technical assessment

• Final Interviews

• Business Fit/Collaboration

• Case Study

• Technical Interview

Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

For more insight into the hiring experience at Monzo, check out our blog post written by one of our Recruiters - Data Hiring at Monzo .

What’s in it for you:

💰 £124,400 - £165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍 This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we’re also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕ And much more - see our full list of benefits .

If you prefer to work part-time, we’ll make this happen whenever we can — whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

#LI-Remote

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

Help build the future of customer operations

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.

This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.

What you’ll do

Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo

You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.

Build strong partnerships at every level

You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.

Drive change, not just delivery

You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets

• Manage cross-collective programmes:

• Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition

• Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery

• Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery

• Drive effective decision making to remove blockers

• Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area

You should apply if:

• You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch

• You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences

• You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further

• You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with

• You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail

• You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution

• You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”

• You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.

• You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery

You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

What makes this role different

Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.

You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.

You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

• Recruiter Call (30 mins) You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.

• Initial Call (45 mins) You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.

• Loop Stage (3 hours) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email tech-hiring@monzo.com

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. • Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.

• Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.

• Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a proven track record of designing high-quality web experiences , with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.

• You’re comfortable using data to inform your design decisions , partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.

• You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.

• You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.

• You can balance speed and experimentation with a high bar for craft, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest in creating an exceptional final experience.

• You’re a natural collaborator who can bring together Product, Engineering, Data, Research and other partners around complex customer problems.

• You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity and direction when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.

• You’re comfortable thinking beyond an individual screen or experiment, connecting work across journeys and helping shape a longer-term vision.

• You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through mentoring, feedback and sharing your expertise.

• You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and the opportunity to help more people discover the value of Monzo.

🙌What’s in it for you

💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.
